reason: The house needs doing after this monsoon and I cannot keep flying back to chase a contractor; one named coordinator, daily WhatsApp photos and 70% held back until the work is checked is the first setup I have seen that I could actually manage from Dubai without leaving it all on my parents. I would book the free site visit and, if the written quote lands near ₹89,000, pay the 30% for a date that falls during my December leave.
objection: ₹2,000 a day is pocket money to them and to me; the real fear is the crew vanishing halfway, my old parents living in a half-painted house with furniture pushed around, and nobody I trust there to judge whether the finish is good before the 70% goes. I also know Asian Paints, not Turbolux, so I am taking a chance on the crew more than the paint.
would_change_my_mind: If the site-visit quote jumps well above ₹89,000, or they will not let me sign off the final payment myself over a video walk-through from Dubai instead of my parents doing it, I would go with an Asian Paints service instead.
